usage.maplibre-gl: Production 2D raster map viewport, tile lifecycle, gestures, markers, GeoJSON polygons and controls. Replaces the custom WebMercator/tile viewport.
usage.@turf/distance: Canonical WGS84 distance used by capture fences and encounter queries.
usage.@turf/circle: Displayed OS uncertainty circle in the MapLibre GeoJSON overlay.

notAdopted.xstate: Current persisted encounter transitions remain small and transaction-bound; adding a second state owner would complicate battle recovery.

customDomainCode: OS permission/precision policy, WGS84/GCJ02 provider boundary, account-owned encounter and capture receipts remain application-specific rules.
